subject.title: fix(tts): defer text settlement for final-mode TTS to eliminate churn (#83511)

question: Should OpenClaw accept `captionedFinalText` as the channel capability contract for deferring final-mode TTS text into voice-note captions?
rationale: The bug fix is plausible, but the PR adds an extension-facing channel capability and changes visible delivery ordering, which requires maintainer intent rather than a purely mechanical repair judgment.

options.title: Accept capability-gated fix after proof
options.body: Keep the dispatcher-level design, require tagged Telegram proof, and merge once the capability docs/tests and delivery fallback are accepted.

options.title: Narrow to Telegram-only behavior
options.body: Avoid exposing a new SDK capability for now and keep the change private to Telegram until the broader channel contract is designed.

options.title: Pause for a delivery-mode redesign
options.body: Defer this PR and decide final-mode TTS delivery semantics together with related separate-text-plus-voice requests.

recommendation.title: Accept capability-gated fix after proof
recommendation.body: Keep the dispatcher-level design, require tagged Telegram proof, and merge once the capability docs/tests and delivery fallback are accepted.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Telegram and TTS channel capability history makes this the best available owner for the extension-facing contract decision.
